🫏 New post ready 📚 List · family · 8 slides “things at grandma's house that take nerve now” 📝 Slides
1. things at grandma's house that take nerve now 2. walking straight past the grown-ups into the pantry and opening a fresh box of biscuits without asking. 3. leaving your sneakers upside down in the front hallway, knowing someone else would set them straight by the door. 4. asking straight across the table why the boy in the silver photo frame never visited. 5. falling asleep across the big armchair at three in the afternoon, trusting the whole house to stay quiet around you. 6. crawling under her quilt at seven on a saturday morning just because the kitchen linoleum was cold on bare feet. 7. walking up to the sink with a splinter in your thumb and handing your hand over without saying a word. 8. save this for the days you forget how safe you once were at that table.
✍️ Caption
it took years to notice that grandma never actually sat down until everyone else had seconds. nobody ever knocked on that screen door back then. save this for an evening when you need to remember how quiet that kitchen was. #grandma #grandparents #grandmashouse
